sloka: ते गत्वा दूरम् अध्वानम् लंबमाने दिवाकरे ।ददृशुः सहिता रंयम् तटाकम् योजन आयुतम् ॥३-११-५॥
transliteration: te gatvā dūram adhvānam laṁbamāne divākare ।dadṛśuḥ sahitā raṁyam taṭākam yojana āyutam ॥3-11-5॥

translations.english: As the Sun was setting, they had covered a long distance, watching a yojanalong tank adorned with lotuses, and crowded with herds of elephants and flocks of cranes, swans and aquatic animals.
translations.hindi: बहुत दूर चल कर, सूर्य डूबने के समय, इन्होंने एक रमण्दीक मील देखी, जो एक योजना लंबी थी
